title: Require an explicit policy before collapsing evaluator signals
narrative: Taloneth refuses silent weighted blends of verifier scores and wants gates and formula version written into the result. Accepts FineEnvs reward aggregation guidance[^fineenvs-objective].
implementation: `ObjectivePolicy` and `aggregate_objective` in `mechaharness.objective_policy` record component signals, formula, version, gates, and prerequisites on every scalar objective.
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/objective_policy_aggregate.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
